parameters.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as articles_collected FROM raw_content WHERE DATE(collected_at) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
SELECT COUNT(*) as signals_detected FROM signals WHERE DATE(detected_at) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
SELECT COUNT(*) as content_ideas_generated FROM content_ideas WHERE DATE(created_at) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
SELECT COUNT(*) as competitor_events FROM competitor_events WHERE DATE(detected_at) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'
SELECT COUNT(*) as pain_points_detected FROM pain_points WHERE DATE(detected_at) = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day'

SELECT SUM(articles_collected) as total_articles, SUM(signals_detected) as total_signals, SUM(content_ideas_generated) as total_content_ideas, SUM(research_hours_saved) as total_hours_saved, SUM(estimated_value_usd) as total_value_usd, COUNT(*) as days_running FROM roi_metrics WHERE metric_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'

INSERT INTO roi_weekly_trends (week_start, total_articles, total_signals, total_content_ideas, total_hours_saved, total_value_usd, days_running, computed_at) SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE), $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, NOW() ON CONFLICT (week_start) DO UPDATE SET total_articles = EXCLUDED.total_articles, total_signals = EXCLUDED.total_signals, total_content_ideas = EXCLUDED.total_content_ideas, total_hours_saved = EXCLUDED.total_hours_saved, total_value_usd = EXCLUDED.total_value_usd, days_running = EXCLUDED.days_running, computed_at = NOW()
